fullPassage: Merely convincing your children that worry is senseless and that they would be more content if they didn’t worry isn’t going to stop them from worrying. For some reason, young people seem to believe that worry is a fact of life over which they have little or no control. Consequently, they don’t even try to stop. Therefore, you need to convince them that worry, like guilt and fear, is nothing more than an emotion, and like all emotions, is subject to the power of the will. Tell them that they can eliminate worry from their lives by simply refusing to attend to it. Explain to them that if they refuse to act worried regardless of how they feel, they will eventually stop feeling worried and will begin to experience the contentment that accompanies a worry-free life.

det.korean: 걱정하는 행동을 거부하면 결국 걱정이 사라지고 만족감을 느끼게 된다
det.analysis:

✅ ② 요지: 행동 거부 → 감정 소멸 ←정답
❌ ③ 경험 통한 성장은 언급 없음
❌ ④ 부모 대리 언급 없음

ch: 걱정은 통제 불가능한 감정이므로 받아들여야 한다.
걱정하는 행동을 거부하면 걱정 감정도 결국 사라진다.
부모가 걱정을 대신 해주면 아이들이 안정된다.

questions.passage: Merely convincing your children that worry is senseless and that they would be more content if they didn’t worry isn’t going to stop them from worrying. For some reason, young people seem to believe that worry is a fact of life over which they have little or no control. Consequently, they don’t even try to stop. Therefore, you need to convince them that worry, like guilt and fear, is nothing more than an emotion, and like all emotions, is subject to the power of the will. Tell them that they can eliminate worry from their lives by simply refusing to attend to it. Explain to them that if they refuse to act worried regardless of how they feel, they will eventually stop feeling worried and will begin to experience the contentment that accompanies a worry-free life.
questions.stem: 다음 글에서 추론할 수 있는 것은?

det.korean: 행동(act worried 거부) → 감정 변화(stop feeling worried) 순서

✅ ③ 행동 변화 → 감정 변화 순서 ←정답
❌ ④ 완전 제거(eliminate) 가능하다고 주장
det.tip: refuse to act → stop feeling → 행동이 감정을 이끈다

ch: 걱정은 유전적 요인에 의해 결정되므로 바꿀 수 없다.

행동을 바꾸면 그에 따라 감정도 변할 수 있다.
걱정을 완전히 없애는 것보다 줄이는 것이 현실적이다.
